_about: Free for All spawns by the spawn rule (the owner, 2026-11-14: "there should be a rule that spawns are inside buildings or close to two walls or some cover", "and none at the perimeter"): on every map but Rudnya and Training Camp, each team-2 spawn that fails the rule (cover, past the perimeter band) or the spawn checks (standing floor, body clear, harmful zones 2 m away) moves to a place that passes them, chosen so the inner area has places to spawn everywhere; one that passes but faces a wall is turned. No distance between spawns is kept ("spawns can be as close as possible"). Generated by scripts/ffa-mode/make_cover_edits.py from cover-maps.tsv (check-points to_cover). Each changed spawn keeps its id, name, radii and protection; only its position and rotation change. The free for all's own projects only; after every Free for All spawn list.
